title: Chemoselective reduction of thioureas to N-methylamines and N,N-dimethylamines using a Cu-based catalyst
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6SU00242K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Yuanchen Jie, Jun Zhu, Yongtao Wang, Jia Yao, Haoran Li
This work reported an earth-abundant-metal-catalyzed hydrogenative reduction of CS2-derived thioureas with PhSiH3 to yield N-methylamines and N,N-dimethylamines, highlighting its potential in sustainable synthesis.
